mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_history (query_image_path, nice_class, model_name, result_count, top_score, top_trademark_id, client_ip, searched_at) VALUES (#{queryImagePath}, #{niceClass}, #{modelName}, #{resultCount}, #{topScore}, #{topTrademarkId}, #{clientIp}, #{searchedAt})

INSERT INTO search_result (history_id, trademark_id, rank_no, score) VALUES
(#{r.historyId}, #{r.trademarkId}, #{r.rankNo}, #{r.score})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM search_result WHERE history_id = #{historyId} ORDER BY rank_no
SELECT * FROM search_history ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM search_history WHERE searched_at >= #{from}
